home.h2: Luxury Marble & Natural Stone Decor for Modern Homes
p: MindMines creates handcrafted marble, granite, onyx and natural stone decor designed for modern European homes. Every piece is made from real stone, which means each product has its own unique pattern, veining and natural character.

Discover premium trays, bowls, cutting boards, candle holders, storage pots, office accessories and bathroom decor made to elevate everyday rituals. Our designs combine minimal aesthetics with durable materials — ideal for kitchens, dining tables, workspaces and living rooms.

We focus on quality, safe packaging and reliable delivery across Germany and the EU. If you are looking for timeless stone accessories that feel luxurious and last for years, explore MindMines collections and find the right piece for your space.

about.h2: About MindMines — Crafted from Stone, Designed for Life
p: MindMines is a Germany-based brand focused on premium natural stone products and handcrafted decor. Our mission is simple: bring the timeless beauty of marble and stone into everyday life through modern, functional design.

We work with skilled artisans and carefully selected materials from renowned stone regions. Natural stone variations are not defects — they are the signature of authenticity. Each item is inspected and packed securely before shipping.
From trays and bowls to storage and office accessories, MindMines pieces are designed to complement modern interiors and make daily routines feel special.
Explore MindMines decorative products made from marble, granite and premium natural stone. Our collection includes trays, bowls, holders, candle stands and storage pieces designed for modern homes.
Natural stone is durable, elegant and naturally unique. Each product features its own colour and veining, making every piece one of a kind.
Use our stone decor in the kitchen, living room, bathroom or office — as functional accessories and premium interior accents.

naturalStone.h2: Natural Stone Collection — Marble, Granite, Travertine & More
p: Discover our natural stone collection for projects, surfaces and custom enquiries. We help you choose the right stone type, colour and finish for your needs — from durable granite to elegant marble and warm travertine.
Natural stone is valued for longevity, heat resistance and timeless aesthetics. Each stone has its own structure and tone, which makes it ideal for unique interior projects.
Send an enquiry with measurements and your preferred finish — our team will respond with guidance and options.

MindMines ships from Germany to customers across Germany and selected EU countries. Orders are typically processed within 48 hours on business days and packed with protective materials suitable for fragile stone products.
Delivery times depend on destination and carrier. Tracking information is provided once your order is dispatched. Please ensure your address details are complete and correct to avoid delays.
If your parcel arrives damaged, contact us within 48 hours and include photos of the packaging and product so we can support you quickly.
You may return eligible items within 14 days of delivery. Returned products must be unused, undamaged and placed back in the original protective packaging.
Because natural stone is heavy and delicate, we recommend insured and trackable return shipping. If an item arrives damaged, contact us within 48 hours with photos and we will review the case.
Refunds are issued after inspection and approval, typically within 7–10 business days to the original payment method.
We respect your privacy and process personal data only as needed to provide our services — for example, to fulfil orders, deliver parcels and provide customer support.
Payment details are handled by secure payment providers. We do not store full card details. Optional analytics or marketing cookies are used only with your consent.
You can request access, correction or deletion of your data according to applicable data protection laws.
These terms describe how purchases, payments, shipping and returns work on MindMines. By using our website and ordering products, you agree to the rules described in our Terms & Conditions.
Product availability may be limited and prices can change. We always aim to provide accurate product information, but natural stone products may have minor variations in colour and pattern.
If you have questions about your order, delivery or returns, contact our support team and we will assist you.
This page contains the legal company details for MindMines, including address, contact information and tax identification required under German law.
If you need to reach us for legal or business enquiries, use the email address listed here and we will respond as soon as possible.
Cookies help our website work correctly — for example, to remember language preferences, keep items in your cart and protect the site from abuse.
Optional analytics or marketing cookies are used only when you give consent through the cookie banner. You can change your cookie preferences at any time.
You can also manage cookies via your browser settings, but disabling essential cookies may affect site functionality.
Need support with an order, delivery, returns or product information? Our customer service team is here to help.
For faster support, include your order number and the email address used during checkout. If your parcel arrives damaged, please attach photos of the box and product.
You can contact us by email or WhatsApp during business hours.
If you placed an order as a guest, you can still track it here. Enter your order number and the email address used at checkout to view the current status and shipping information.
If your invoice is not available yet, it may still be processing — it will appear after payment confirmation.
If you cannot find your order, double-check the email address and order number from the confirmation email.
The page you are looking for may have moved, been renamed, or no longer exists.
Use the navigation menu to explore our collections or return to the homepage to continue shopping.

about.storyParagraph1: Our journey began long before MindMines was founded — as passionate explorers of marble and natural stone. What started as a deep admiration for the timeless beauty of raw materials soon grew into a commitment to bring the world’s finest stones into everyday living.
about.storyParagraph2: For years, we travelled, learned, and traded, carefully sourcing exquisite marble, granite, soapstone, and rare natural stones from different parts of the world. Each stone we encountered had its own story, its own patterns, and its own personality — and we believed these unique characteristics deserved to be celebrated, not hidden.
about.storyParagraph3: In 2022, this passion took a new shape. We established MindMines with a clear mission: to share exceptional materials and authentic craftsmanship with a global audience. We understood that a stone is not just a piece of nature — it is a piece of history, shaped over thousands of years. And when placed in the hands of a skilled artisan, it transforms into art that carries emotion, tradition, and culture.
about.storyParagraph4: Today, MindMines stands as a house of creativity and craftsmanship. Inspired by the ideas and trust of our customers, we work closely with talented artisans to create sculptures, home décor, utility pieces, and custom-made designs. Whether crafted from marble, granite, or even humble pebbles, each product is thoughtfully designed to resonate with elegance, purity, and timeless sophistication.
about.storyParagraph5: Our purpose remains unchanged: to connect people with art born from the earth — art that lasts, inspires, and adds meaning to the spaces we live in.

privacy.section7_text: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, including tax compliance, fraud prevention, and customer service. In many cases, order-related data is retained for up to 10 years per German tax law.
privacy.section8_text: You have the right to access, correct, erase, or restrict the processing of your data, the right to data portability, and the right to object to certain processing activities, including marketing. You may withdraw your consent at any time.

returns.title: Refund & Return Policy
returns.intro: This Refund & Return Policy explains how MindMines handles returns, refunds, and exchanges for purchases made through our online shop.
returns.section1_text: You may return items purchased from MindMines within 14 days from the date of delivery, without giving any reason. To start a return, please contact us at service@mindmines.eu with your order number and details of the item(s) you wish to return.
returns.section2_text: Returned items must be in their original condition, unused and undamaged, with all original packaging and protective materials. Items that show signs of use, scratches, or damage may be rejected and sent back to you at your cost.
returns.section3_text: Custom-made or personalized items and items that are clearly marked as non-returnable on the product page cannot be returned, except where required by law.
returns.section4_text: To initiate a return, please contact us at service@mindmines.eu before sending any items back. We will provide you with instructions and the correct return address. Returns sent without prior contact may not be accepted.
returns.section5_text: You are responsible for the cost of return shipping, unless the item is faulty or damaged upon arrival. We recommend using an insured and trackable shipping service, as you are responsible for the goods until they reach us.
returns.section6_text: If your item arrives damaged or defective, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the product and packaging. Once we review and confirm the issue, we will offer a replacement or refund in accordance with your statutory rights.
returns.section7_text: Once your return is received and inspected, we will notify you by email. If approved, a refund of the product price will be processed to your original payment method within 7–10 business days. Original shipping charges may not be refunded, except where required by law.
returns.section8_text: We currently do not offer direct exchanges. If you would like a different item, please return the original product according to this policy and place a new order.
returns.section9_text: For questions regarding returns, refunds, or this policy, please contact us at service@mindmines.eu.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.intro: This Shipping Policy explains how MindMines handles the processing, shipping, and delivery of orders placed through our online shop.
shipping.section1_text: All orders are processed and shipped from Germany. We aim to provide a safe and reliable delivery service for all MindMines products.
shipping.section2_text: Orders are usually processed and dispatched within 48 hours (on working days, Monday to Friday), excluding public holidays. During busy periods, processing times may be slightly longer.
shipping.section3_text: We currently ship within Germany and selected countries within the European Union. If you are located outside the EU and would like to place an order, please contact us at service@mindmines.eu to check individual shipping options.
shipping.section4_text: We offer free delivery on orders unless otherwise stated at checkout. Any additional shipping charges (for example, for special services or remote areas) will be clearly displayed during the checkout process before you confirm your order.
shipping.section5_text: Delivery times vary depending on the destination country and the shipping service used. Within Germany, delivery usually takes 2–5 working days after dispatch. For other EU countries, delivery may take longer. Please note that delivery times are estimates and not guaranteed.
shipping.section6_text: Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email and, where available, a tracking number. Please ensure that your delivery address details are complete and correct. We are not responsible for delays or failed deliveries caused by incorrect or incomplete address information.
shipping.section7_text: If a parcel cannot be delivered and is returned to us due to reasons such as an incorrect address, uncollected parcel, or refusal of acceptance, we may charge you for re-shipping the order. Refunds for undeliverable parcels are handled in accordance with our Refund & Return Policy.
shipping.section8_text: If your order arrives visibly damaged, please document the damage with photographs of the outer packaging and the product, and contact us within 48 hours at service@mindmines.eu. We will review your case and offer a suitable solution in line with your statutory rights.
shipping.section9_text: For deliveries outside the European Union (if offered), local customs duties, taxes, or import fees may apply. These charges are the responsibility of the customer and are not included in our product prices or shipping costs.
shipping.section10_text: If you have any questions about shipping, delivery times, or your order status, please contact us at service@mindmines.eu.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how MindMines uses cookies and similar technologies on this website.
cookies.section1_text: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the website remember your actions and preferences over a period of time.
cookies.section2_text: We use different types of cookies to operate and improve our website, including strictly necessary cookies, performance cookies, functional cookies, and, where applicable, cookies for marketing or analytics.
cookies.section3_text: Cookies help us ensure the technical functioning of the website, remember your language and region preferences, analyze traffic and usage patterns, and improve the overall user experience.
cookies.section4_text: For strictly necessary cookies, the legal basis is our legitimate interest in providing a secure and functional website. For all other cookies, we rely on your consent, which is obtained when you first visit our website via the cookie banner or settings.
cookies.section5_text: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. You may also withdraw your consent for non-essential cookies at any time by adjusting your cookie preferences if such a tool is provided on our website. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality and performance of the site.
cookies.section6_text: We may use third-party services (such as analytics providers or embedded content from other websites) that place cookies on your device. These third parties have their own privacy and cookie policies, which we recommend you review.
cookies.section7_text: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, law, or our services. Any updates will be posted on this page.
cookies.section8_text: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at service@mindmines.eu.

policy.careText: Care Instructions: For natural stone surfaces, like marble, use gentle pH-neutral cleaners and a soft cloth. Quickly wipe up spills to prevent stains. Use trivets and coasters to protect from heat. Dust regularly and clean softly. Occasionally apply a stone protector. Avoid using abrasive materials or harsh chemicals to keep your stone beautiful and lasting.
delivery_content: Free Delivery: We offer free delivery on all orders.
Fast Dispatch: All orders are dispatched within 48 hours.
Delivery Options: At checkout, you will see delivery options based on your items and shipping address.
Quality Checked: Every product is inspected by our quality control team and documented before leaving our warehouse.
returns_content: 14-Day Return Window: You may return your product within 14 days of delivery.
If the customer is not satisfied: We refund the product cost.
If the product arrives damaged during transport: We refund the product cost + shipping cost.
Return Shipping: Return shipping costs are paid by the customer.
Insurance Recommended: We recommend returning the package with insurance, as we cannot refund items that arrive damaged in return shipping.
Packaging: Please use the original box and packing materials. Items with signs of use, scratches, or damage cannot be accepted.
Refund Time: Once processed, refunds are issued within 7 working days.
